about: Hand-labelled outcomes for the six tasks in this directory, frozen before delivery-outcomes.js was written. Every field is checked per task by tooling/test-delivery-outcomes.js. costUsd sums every attempt's worker cost (failed ones included) plus judge cost; null means some attempt's cost cannot be read.
summary: tasks=6 attempts=9 first_attempt_accepted=2 accepted=4 standing_day7=3 unknown=1

alpha.reason: one attempt accepted by the Brain, PR 101 merged and neither reverted nor reopened in the 7 days after merge

bravo.reason: attempt 1 judged follow-up (its 0.05 judge cost counts), attempt 2 accepted and landed through PRs 102 and 103, both merged and clean for 7 days

charlie.reason: attempt 1 failed (its 0.40 counts), attempt 2 accepted by the judge (0.04), PR 104 merged then reverted two days later

delta.reason: one attempt accepted, PR 105 merged; its issue was reopened 10 days after merge, outside the 7-day window, so it stood on day 7

echo.reason: both attempts failed, the Brain escalated the second, and nothing was tried for over 7 days: abandoned

foxtrot.reason: a 42-day-old run that succeeded but never got a verdict and whose log is gone: unknown, neither a success nor a failure
